payload.title: PHP reaches libvips through the vips program, not FFI or the PECL extension
payload.context: Images (#25): FFI needs ffi.enable globally and the stack check off, and loads the decoder into the one FrankenPHP process. The PECL extension is deprecated.
payload.rationale: Each step is a short process with fixed arguments, no shell, a time limit and none of the application environment, so a decoder crash fails one upload and no key is in reach of it.
payload.consequences: Five to eleven short processes per upload, about 0.1 s. Intermediate files go to a temporary folder per upload, up to about 600 MB for the largest allowed image.
